baseline.title: Relatively τ-elliptic element
baseline.description: A relatively τ-semisimple element γ whose relevant twisted centralizer,modulo the central torus specified by the involution setup,is anisotropic over the ground field.

current.title: Relatively τ-elliptic element
current.description: In the commuting-involution setup G=Res_(M/F)G₀, θ=στ, a relatively τ-semisimple γ is relatively τ-elliptic if C^τ_(G,δ)/Z(G₀), with δ=γγ^(−θ), is anisotropic over the ground field. The centralizer here is in all G; anisotropy of a possibly disconnected reductive quotient means its identity component has no nontrivial split torus.
